name: Automotive & Auto Components
challenge: Tier-1 and Tier-2 auto component suppliers face rigid OEM delivery schedules, tight price compressions, high changeover frequencies, and strict zero-defect quality standards.
approach: We deploy line balancing, SMED quick changeover, Poka-Yoke error-proofing, and synchronized Kanban pull systems tailored for high-mix auto assembly lines.
outcomes: 35% Productivity Improvement on assembly lines
72% Changeover Reduction on stamping and welding lines
Zero-defect Quality Assurance through Karakuri and Poka-Yoke

name: Steel & Metallurgy
challenge: Capital-intensive steel mills and metal processing plants suffer from furnace-to-mill scheduling delays, high energy costs, and constraint equipment downtime.
approach: We apply Theory of Constraints (TOC), Drum-Buffer-Rope bottleneck scheduling, and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) to maximize rolling mill output without Capex.
outcomes: 30% Lead Time Reduction from slab furnace to dispatch
20-35% Output Capacity Expansion on bottleneck mills
Significant reduction in energy and fuel conversion costs

name: Foundry & Casting
challenge: Foundries contend with heavy manual labor requirements, sand handling delays, casting scrap defects, and poor floor layout ergonomics.
approach: We implement Industrial Engineering time-and-motion studies, moulding shop layout redesign, low-cost mechanical hoists, and scrap reduction Kaizens.
outcomes: 35% Manpower Optimisation in core and moulding shops
25% reduction in casting rework and scrap rates
Streamlined material flow and safer shopfloor ergonomics

name: Packaging & FIBC
challenge: Bulk packaging and FIBC manufacturers deal with long extrusion setup times, high loom downtime, labor-intensive sewing operations, and material waste.
approach: We implement SMED setup reduction on extrusion lines, loom OEE tracking, line balancing in sewing bays, and standardized material handling routes.
outcomes: 18% OEE Improvement across extrusion and weaving looms
72% Changeover Reduction on film lines
30% Lead Time Reduction from polymer raw material to finished FIBC dispatch

name: Precision Engineering
challenge: High-precision machining job shops face low CNC spindle utilization, prolonged fixture setups, complex part routing, and customer lead time pressures.
approach: We introduce modular zero-point fixture standardization, offline tool presetting, SMED on CNC centers, and visual scheduling boards.
outcomes: 72% Changeover Reduction across CNC machining centers
20-30% increase in spindle runtime availability
95%+ On-Time In-Full (OTIF) dispatch performance

name: Heavy Manufacturing
challenge: Heavy equipment fabricators deal with long product travel distances, crisscrossing crane logistics, high WIP inventory, and long fabrication cycle times.
approach: We redesign plant layouts for unidirectional material flow, optimize cutting-to-welded bay logistics, and establish visual WIP management bays.
outcomes: 30% Lead Time Reduction for heavy structural fabrications
35% reduction in material handling and crane travel distance
25% floor space freed for new assembly capacity

name: Wire & Cables
challenge: Wire & Cable plants suffer from continuous drawing die wear, frequent extruder color changeover downtime, rewinding scrap, and high energy consumption.
approach: We implement SMED extruder setup reduction, line speed optimization on drawing lines, automated tension control standard work, and tension scrap Kaizens.
outcomes: 30% Manpower Optimisation across wire drawing & cabling bays
28% OEE Improvement on extrusion and stranding lines
40% Changeover Cut on polymer compound switches

name: Textile & Apparel
challenge: Spinning mills and weaving sheds struggle with yarn breakages, long warp beam changeover downtime, and high WIP inventory.
approach: We deploy SMED beam-gaiting protocols on weaving looms, speed optimization on spinning frames, and visual 5S supermarket controls.
outcomes: 38% Inventory Improvement across yarn & fabric WIP
32% Line Productivity Uplift across sewing bays
45% Warp Beam Changeover Time Reduction

name: FMCG & Consumer Goods
challenge: High-speed FMCG bottling and packaging lines lose efficiency to micro-stoppages, frequent SKU format changes, liquid compounding delays, and sealing defects.
approach: We execute video SMED setup compression for filling nozzles, capping heads, and cartoning guides, combined with TPM Autonomous Maintenance pillars.
outcomes: 25% OEE Uplift on high-speed packaging lines
50% SKU Format Changeover Cut
Significant reduction in sachet & foil sealing defects

name: Electricals & Electronics
challenge: Switchgear, transformer, and SMT PCB plants face long feeder setup times, labor-intensive coil winding bottlenecks, and complex wiring harness assembly errors.
approach: We establish offline feeder cart prep, SMT SMED quick changeovers, cellular assembly bay layouts, and Poka-Yoke error-proofing fixtures.
outcomes: 35% Assembly Cycle Time Compression
48% SMT Feeder Setup Time Cut
Zero-Defect Quality Assurance through mechanical Poka-Yoke
